nativeFunctions.name: func_0800127C_708CBC
nativeFunctions.observed: Inline work is at task+0xD0. E0 is desired Y; E4 is interpolation step. Signed phase-1 schedule/frame comparison selects 0.05 or 0.4; phases 3/4 use the verified sine wobble while frame<60. Phase 2 has no phase body. The common epilogue sets result 1 only when current Y > -10. Result 3 forces phase 7; result 4 increments the local balloon phase once then forces phase 7.

nativeFunctions.name: func_080018E8_709328
nativeFunctions.observed: The signed timer word at task+0x84 divided by 30 equaling zero selects phase 5. The following scan admits phase 6 when ANY of six target signed bytes at task+0xD1 equals 1: it first writes 3 to every target result byte, then writes 4 to the matching target. This result-4 write drives the target callback’s one-step local balloon pop transition. Timer check precedes target scan; terminal child cleanup occurs next callback at phase frame 1. Existing native branches alone do not establish phase 5/6 as named win/loss outcomes.

nativeFunctions.name: func_08000CC8_708708
nativeFunctions.observed: Phase 1 treats status68 bit0x8000 as the held gate; the free path installs collider helper argument20 and gravity byte75=10. Contact status68&0x3200 or object Y<0 sets result byte+0xD1 to zero; root retirement observes zero on a later callback. Common gravity subtracts unsigned byte75/50; the integration gate adds velocity*2.

nativeFunctions.name: func_08000FCC_708A0C
nativeFunctions.observed: Phase 2 plays the pop sound, attempts File48 flash creation, creates five common particles and three common debris children only on successful flash creation, then deletes the balloon. This path uses allocation, RNG and audio. Inspected callbacks contain no outgoing damage, score, reward or item-spawn call.

nativeFunctions.name: func_0800126C_708CAC
nativeFunctions.observed: Increments the byte at task+0xD0 once. The target result-4 path uses this to advance the local balloon into its pop phase.

nativeFunctions.name: func_80003E10_4A10
nativeFunctions.observed: ABI float(unsigned int angle): integer word in a0, float result in f0. Masks input to low 10 bits, reflects/signs table quadrants, returns a lookup value without gameplay-state updates.

nativeFunctions.name: func_801E55D4_5A14E4
nativeFunctions.observed: ABI void(player*,float localX,float localY,float localZ). Rotates supplied velocity and fixed local offset by current player angles, writes held object world position/velocity/angles, then detaches it. Sudden Impact caller uses (0,4.4,1.8). Writes are complete on return; the operation is local-player stateful.

relatedNativeMechanics.name: func_80218090_5D3560
relatedNativeMechanics.observed: Creates a local rotating debris child used by the inspected balloon pop path; the child continues through native initialization and its own visual lifecycle.

relatedNativeMechanics.name: func_80218C28_5D40F8
relatedNativeMechanics.observed: Common child constructor used in pop descendants; initializes child kind and flags such that the inspected cosmetic descendants do not advertise outgoing attacks.

limitations: No livegame or visual confirmation was performed.
The no-damage/no-reward finding is scoped to the listed Sudden Impact callback chain and identified pop descendants, not all native effects.
The target/helper and balloon task pointers are local native handles and are not safe network pointers.
The native controller can override target result bytes; prediction alone does not own terminal admission.
